title: Hiking Journal Printable, Trail Log Book PDF, 52 Hike Tracker, Hiking Gift for Hikers, Hike Log Pages, Bucket List, Miles Tracker
description:
Remember every trail. A 64-page printable hiking journal for one year of hikes, made for hikers and as a gift for one.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- How to use and print it (card stock, double-sided, binder or spiral)
- About me and my hiking goals for the year
- 52-hike year tracker and a miles / km total tracker
- Trail bucket list and a favorite hikes hall of fame
- 52 hike log pages: date, trail, park, distance in miles and km, elevation gain in ft and m, time, difficulty, weather, companions, conditions, wildlife, best moment, and a sketch or photo box
- Gear that worked, trail snacks, notes and a year-end reflection

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
For personal use. Print the pages you need, as many times as you like for yourself.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
